link.title: Build a drone in TypeScript
link.description: The quadcopter the Rete and Blockly tutorials build, written in the TypeScript editor as a script of many files, with a picture after every step: its sizes and a lit stage, a carbon frame with hexagon vents, a function that repeats a part around the drone, an arm with its motor, propeller, bolts and light, a canopy with a honeycomb and the bitbybit logo, sprung landing legs and a camera. The finished drone is the TypeScript showcase.
